_about: Copy to detector.json next to vlm_grab.py to switch the car's object finder. No detector.json (or backend vlm) = the laptop VLM, exactly as before.
_model: yolo export model=best.pt format=onnx imgsz=416 opset=12  (class names travel inside the .onnx)
_engine: auto = ultralytics if installed, else onnxruntime if installed, else OpenCV's cv2.dnn (already on the cars)
_targets: classes the car should pick up; anything else the model sees is ignored. Use "all" for every class.
